title: SOLAR STORM
text: The Sun just threw out a cloud of fast charged particles. It will hit the spacecraft in a few hours.

choices.label: Enter SAFE MODE for 15 days
choices.effect: Protected the spacecraft but lost 15 days of science

choices.label: Keep observing
choices.effect: Risked radiation damage to keep collecting science

title: MICROMETEOROID HIT
text: A dust grain smaller than a grain of sand hit the spacecraft at 10 km/s and damaged a power cable.

choices.label: Reroute power ($10 M)
choices.effect: Engineers rerouted power; no lasting damage

choices.label: Live with it
choices.effect: 25% of the power is lost for the rest of the mission

title: BATTERY WEARING OUT
text: After thousands of trips through the planet's shadow, some battery cells are wearing out.

choices.label: Charge the battery more gently
choices.effect: Gentler charging saved most of the battery (10% capacity lost)

choices.label: Keep charging normally
choices.effect: The battery lost 35% of its capacity

title: SOLAR WING STUCK
text: A solar wing motor jammed. The wing is no longer facing the Sun properly.

choices.label: Try a 'wiggle' fix ($15 M, 70% chance)
choices.effect: Engineers tried to free the wing by rocking it back and forth

choices.label: Live with it
choices.effect: 30% of the solar power is lost

fix.label: Wiggle the stuck solar wing ($15 M)

title: RADIATION SPIKE
text: This orbit passes through a part of Jupiter's radiation belts that is much stronger than predicted.

choices.label: SAFE MODE for 12 days
choices.effect: Hid from the radiation but lost 12 days of science

choices.label: Push through
choices.effect: Risked electronics damage to keep working

title: GROUND STATION DOWN
text: A big storm on Earth wrecked your ground station antenna. No contact for 40 days unless you find another antenna.

choices.label: Rent a partner agency's antenna ($6 M)
choices.effect: Another space agency's antenna kept the data flowing

choices.label: Wait it out
choices.effect: 40 days with no data sent to Earth (memory overflowed)

title: MEMORY ERROR
text: The onboard memory reports errors. A bit flipped, maybe from a cosmic ray.

choices.label: Reformat memory (delete stored data)
choices.effect: Lost the data waiting in memory, but the memory is healthy again

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.effect: Risked the computer crashing

title: BUDGET CUT
text: Headquarters cut your operations budget. Pay from your reserve, or end the mission early.

choices.label: Pay $20 M from the reserve
choices.effect: The mission continues, but less money is left over

choices.label: End the mission 6 months early
choices.effect: Saved money, lost 6 months of science

fix.label: Pay the cut from the reserve ($20 M)

title: WILDFIRES SPOTTED!
text: Huge wildfires just broke out. Firefighters are asking for images right now!

choices.label: Point the camera at the fires
choices.effect: Images helped firefighters and earned bonus science

choices.label: Stay on the normal plan
choices.effect: Missed a chance to help and to study the fires

fix.label: Point the instruments at the target

title: POSSIBLE WATER ICE!
text: Your instruments see a hint of water ice inside a permanently dark crater near the south pole.

choices.label: Spend $3 M on extra passes
choices.effect: Confirmed the ice: a big discovery

choices.label: Stay on the normal plan
choices.effect: The hint of ice was never confirmed

fix.label: Point the instruments at the target

title: GLOBAL DUST STORM!
text: A dust storm is spreading across all of Mars, a rare chance to study how it grows.

choices.label: Point every instrument at it
choices.effect: Studied the storm in detail (and drained the battery)

choices.label: Stay on the normal plan
choices.effect: Missed the global dust storm

fix.label: Point the instruments at the target

title: VOLCANO ON IO!
text: A giant volcano is erupting on Io, Jupiter's moon. Getting closer means more radiation.

choices.label: Go for a closer look
choices.effect: Captured the eruption, but took some radiation damage

choices.label: Stay on the normal plan
choices.effect: Missed the eruption on Io

fix.label: Point the instruments at the target

title: ICE PLUME ON ENCELADUS!
text: Enceladus is spraying ice from an ocean under its surface. Fly through the plume to taste it?

choices.label: Fly through the plume
choices.effect: Sampled an alien ocean (with some risk from ice grains)

choices.label: Stay on the normal plan
choices.effect: Missed the chance to sample the plume

fix.label: Point the instruments at the target

title: COMET PASSING!
text: A comet is passing nearby. Turning to watch it costs extra operations time.

choices.label: Turn to observe ($5 M)
choices.effect: Observed the comet: bonus science

choices.label: Stay on the normal plan
choices.effect: Let the comet pass by

fix.label: Point the instruments at the target

title: SOLAR CONJUNCTION
text: The Sun is moving between Earth and Mars. Its radio noise will scramble all signals for about 2 weeks. This really happens every 26 months!

choices.label: Pause all commands and let the spacecraft wait safely
choices.effect: No commands for 2 weeks, but the spacecraft stayed safe

choices.label: Keep sending commands through the noise
choices.effect: Garbled commands risked confusing the spacecraft

title: STAR TRACKER BLINDED
text: The star tracker, the camera that tells the spacecraft which way it is pointing, is blinded by sunlight.

choices.label: Switch to backup gyroscopes ($5 M)
choices.effect: Gyroscopes kept the spacecraft pointed correctly

choices.label: Wait for it to recover
choices.effect: Drifted for 10 days with no science

title: THRUSTER LEAK
text: A small thruster valve is stuck open and propellant is leaking, slowly spinning the spacecraft.

choices.label: Close the valve, use backup thrusters ($8 M)
choices.effect: Leak stopped; backup thrusters took over

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.effect: The spinning spacecraft risked serious damage

title: SOFTWARE CRASH
text: The flight computer crashed and rebooted itself. Engineers found the bug that caused it.

choices.label: Upload a software patch ($6 M)
choices.effect: The patched software runs smoothly

choices.label: Reboot and hope it doesn't happen again
choices.effect: The bug was still there

title: RING-PLANE CROSSING!
text: The orbit crosses Saturn's ring plane: a rare chance to measure ring particles up close (tiny grains might hit).

choices.label: Measure the rings
choices.effect: Measured the ring particles: big science

choices.label: Stay on the normal plan
choices.effect: Missed the ring-plane crossing

fix.label: Point the instruments at the target

title: EUROPA FLYBY!
text: The orbit passes close to Europa, an icy moon with an ocean under its ice. Closer means more radiation.

choices.label: Image Europa up close
choices.effect: Mapped Europa's cracked ice shell

choices.label: Stay on the normal plan
choices.effect: Missed the Europa flyby

fix.label: Point the instruments at the target

title: RELAY OFFER
text: A partner agency's orbiter offers to relay your data to Earth: more contact time for a small fee.

choices.label: Accept the relay ($3 M)
choices.effect: +3 hours a day of contact through the partner's orbiter

choices.label: No thanks
choices.effect: Declined the relay offer
